source:
The mother of my childhood friend and close buddy who lives next door — Miori Shizuku.

She looked after me, a boy with no parents, with the same care she gave her son. I had admired her since I was a child, and before I knew it, I had fallen in love with her.

She is my first love, and even now, I love her more than anyone. But she’s my friend’s mother, and she has a husband. No matter how much I love her, my feelings will never be reciprocated. Even so, I could never cut away my feelings for my friend’s mother, Shizuku-san.

At the very least, I wanted to tell her how I feel. But to Shizuku-san, I’m just a child. If I ever confessed my love to her, she would surely distance herself from me.

No matter how I look at it, this is a love that can never come true. Convinced of that, I kept suppressing my feelings — until one day, my childhood friend couldn’t stand watching me agonize over it any longer and told me about a certain app.

Shizuku-san’s son, Miori Haruto, told me about the existence of the “Absolute Fulfillment Love App” — a god-tier app that had become famous in certain circles.

“There’s no way such a convenient app exists. It’s obviously a scam.”
Even as I thought that, I decided to try the app on Shizuku-san, on the off chance it might work. When I mustered my courage, launched the app, and showed Shizuku-san the video that appeared on my smartphone, to my shock… she fell into a hypnotic trance!?

To the dazed Shizuku-san, I confessed all the feelings I’d been holding back:
“I love you! Please be my lover.”

“Ufufu… Actually, I’ve been interested in you too, Kou-kun. If you’re okay with an old lady like me, I’d love to go out with you.”

The effect of the dubious love app was overwhelming. Shizuku-san accepted my confession and became my lover.

The woman I had yearned for all this time — Miori Shizuku. Even though she is much older than me, her body is every bit as fresh and youthful as any girl my age. Petite in stature, yet boasting massive J-cup breasts measuring 105 cm, and a plump, thick, voluptuous ass.

After experiencing sex for the first time as lovers with the perfect girlfriend, someone who has everything I could ever want, I became addicted to the pleasure. Now, careful not to let my friend find out, I crave and devour the body of his mother, Shizuku-san, almost every single day.

Shizuku-san accept me, who desire her body like a male in heat, with her innate maternal warmth.

No one knows how long the app’s hypnotic effect will last. While living in fear that this false relationship might crumble, I’ll keep embracing my beloved girlfriend — Haruto’s mother, Shizuku-san — again today.
